lead: Kamal Haasan is best known as an Indian actor, born on 7 November 1954 in Paramakudi.
As of 2026, he is 71 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Kamal Haasan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Kamal Haasan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Kamal Haasan was born on 7 November 1954 in Paramakudi, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, D Srinivasan. He is a sibling of Charuhasan and Chandrahasan.
His listed education includes Hindu Higher Secondary School.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam and English.

sections.heading: Kamal Haasan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Kamal Haasan works primarily as an actor, film producer, screenwriter, film director, choreographer and singer.
He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha. He is affiliated with Makkal Neethi Maiyam.

sections.heading: Kamal Haasan — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
paras: He has been married to Vani Ganapathy (married 1978, until 1988) and Sarika (married 1988, until 2004).
He is a parent to Shruti Haasan and Akshara Haasan.
